mechanism: Olanzapine may increase risk of hyponatremia and electrolyte disturbances; zoledronic acid can cause acute phase reactions and electrolyte abnormalities; both drugs have potential to affect renal function and bone metabolism.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and fluid balance regularly; assess for hyponatremia symptoms; consider baseline and periodic assessment of calcium, phosphate, and magnesium levels.
